name: Lucifer
source:
The Supreme Overlord of Hell.

Lucifer is a very angry, imposing individual. They always get their way, even if they need to send a few losers down wormholes.

[From [url=https://reineworks.itch.io/-the-tail-makes-the-fox]itch.io[/url]]
